sections.title: The Bridge from Geometry to Abstraction
lecture_lines: Vectors are more than just arrows in space.
We focus on behavior and interaction rules.
Any object following these rules is a vector.
animations: Fade in a simple arrow representing a spatial vector at center. Color: #FFFFFF. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]
Highlight the arrow with a bright pulse effect. Color: #FFD700.
Transform the arrow into a generic abstract blob to represent any vector. Color: #00BFFF. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]

sections.title: The Eight Axioms: The Rules of the Game
lecture_lines: Vector spaces rely on eight specific axioms.
These define addition and scalar multiplication rules.
They ensure consistency across different systems.
Everything must satisfy closure and identity.
Inverse and distributive laws are also required.
animations: Fade in a list of eight icons representing axioms. Color: #FFFFFF.
Highlight 'Addition' and 'Scalar Multiplication' text labels. Color: #32CD32.
Flash a checkmark icon next to the axiom list. Color: #FFFF00.
Fade in 'Closure' and 'Identity' text labels. Color: #FFA500.
Fade in 'Inverse' and 'Distributive' text labels. Color: #FF4500.

sections.title: Beyond Arrows: Unexpected Spaces
lecture_lines: Vectors can be matrices, functions, or sequences.
They all obey identical structural rules.
This expands our mathematical toolbox significantly.
Addition follows the same logic as arrows.
Scaling behaves predictably across all spaces.

Draw equal signs between them to show they share rules. Color: #00CED1.
Flash a box around all three items together. Color: #FF1493.

Animate the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/matrix.svg] and [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/function.svg] shifting to mimic vector addition. Color: #98FB98.

sections.title: Applied Logic: The 'Animal Weight' Problem
lecture_lines: Can a set of animals be vectors?
We test if they satisfy core axioms.
Biological sets usually fail the inverse requirement.
animations: Display an icon set of different animals using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/animal.svg]. Color: #FFFFFF.
Overlay a question mark symbol over the set. Color: #FF6347.
Display a broken 'Inverse' rule icon with a red X. Color: #FF0000.

sections.title: Summary and Synthesis
lecture_lines: Vector spaces are defined by their structure.
They serve as foundations for modern science.
Abstraction empowers us to solve complex problems.
